ticket: I’ve been trying to get into the app for the past 2 hours, and everyone on my team is saying it’s just not loading — the login page comes up blank, and we can’t even see the dashboards, which is a total mess for our daily planning meetings. I’m not sure if it’s my computer or something deeper, but it’s like the whole service is down.

SSO not syncing with our directory anymore, all team members can't log in, no fallback auth method, can't access projects or dashboards at all, also the export tool keeps freezing every 10 minutes but we can't use it anyway.
We were charged $1,200 for the March plan upgrade, but we never agreed to that. We want a full refund since the change was not approved in our admin panel.

I'm so sorry to be writing this in such a panic — our entire sales team can't access the Northbeam dashboard right now, and the login page just keeps loading a white screen with no error message. We've tried refreshing, switching browsers, and even rebooting the office network, but nothing works. This happened exactly at 9:15 AM, and now we can't close the orders for tomorrow's shipment. We’re worried this might impact our customer commitments, especially since the invoice for order #ORD-98427 was already pending approval and we can’t track it through the system. I know this is a massive disruption and I’m truly sorry for the inconvenience, but I need immediate help to resolve this so our team can get back online.

I'm having trouble with the export functionality in the reporting module — specifically, when trying to generate a monthly financial summary, the data appears to be missing or incomplete, and it's only happening on the last few days of the month. I’ve managed to work around it by manually copying the data into Excel, but it’s extremely time-consuming and increases the risk of errors. In a separate note, I’ve also noticed that the dashboard refreshes very slowly when I navigate between reports, which is a minor inconvenience, but I’m not sure if that’s related to the same issue.
I'm sorry to be so urgent, but I need to export all my company data for my tax records and can't find a way to do it in the app.

So I'm the IT admin for this nonprofit that uses Northbeam, and we've been having some trouble with SSO lately — I remember setting it up last year with Google, but now when I go to log in, it just keeps looping me back to the password reset page, even though I've already reset it and can't figure out what's going on. I think maybe the SSO config was accidentally changed or something, and I'm not sure if it's a bug or if the device I used to log in got wiped or something. Also, I can't access the admin panel at all, so I'm not even sure if I can change anything in the settings or verify the SSO credentials. Honestly, I've been trying to fix this for the past two hours and just can't get past the login loop, and I'm starting to worry that we might have an issue with the SSO sync or maybe someone else got access, but I don't have any evidence of that yet. I just need to get back in so I can check the user list and make sure everything's working correctly.

I'm sorry to bother you, but I need to request a complete export of all data from my account, including project timelines, team member assignments, and financial summaries — I'm doing a transition to a different software and need everything for audit purposes. Could you please let me know how long it will take to process this request and when I can expect access to the full dataset?

I'm really sorry to be reaching out so urgently, as I've been trying to keep our subscription running smoothly, but I'm now concerned about the data security and privacy — I've noticed some inconsistencies in how data is being stored and accessed, and I'm considering switching to a competitor. Could you please help me export all the data I've generated under this account since January, and confirm what data is stored and how it's protected? I've been working on sensitive financial reports and I need to ensure everything is secure and accessible for audit purposes.

We need a way to export team-wide project milestones in a CSV format, not just individual tasks. Currently, the export tool only gives us task lists, no timeline view. No timeline, no reporting. Can we add that option?
Gantt view off by 2 days today. Happens intermittently. Not blocking any work. How long till fix?

We’ve been using Northbeam for a year and would love to see a new template for client onboarding that includes pre-filled fields and automated email triggers. This would save our team a lot of time during new client setup.
